description: Permanently delete a project, all its services AND its data (databases, files). Needs an admin-scope key and a human approval: the first call deletes nothing and returns status `needs_approval` with an approval link (15 minutes); after the user approves in the browser, the page shows a one-time `approval_token`, and a call with it performs the deletion.

approval_token.description: One-time token from the approval page (rva_...).

confirm_token.description: Older API versions only; current ones use approval_token.

project.description: Project slug to delete (required, never inferred).

name: destroy
title: Destroy project
